summary: R9b verification (backend + frontend). P0 DPR fix VERIFIED: vendor and admin DPR modals now always use /dpr/analyze-async + polling; 25-page text PDF analysed in ~25-36s with live progress (queued -> mapped chunks -> drafting x/15 sections) and success; blank/image-only PDF fails with the clear scanned-PDF message ('[reading upload] Could not read any text ... scanned/image-only PDF'). The only '1 DPR(s) failed' toast seen was for the deliberately blank PDF. AI Fill All background job verified via API (total/resumed/404 cross-owner/409 on submitted/only_empty preserved existing body/immediate done when nothing to fill) and UI (tb-fill-progress, tb-fill-phase, tb-fill-count, tb-fill-bar 0->25->50->75%, then toast 'AI drafted 4 section(s)' and template reloaded with bodies). Reviewer inline preview verified (tr-preview-modal header + sanitized sections, DOMPurify stripped injected <script>/onerror, close, request-changes from modal, Pending library master reject from modal, approve button wired: it showed the backend 422 'missing required fields: description' for my test draft, so the call is made correctly). Scope rules: GET/PUT (CSRF + role enforced, validation 422 on negative), UI card save persisted across reload, vendor /scope snapshot + vendor-scope-strip, submit enforcement 422/403(case-insensitive match OK)/429, 0 = no limit, restrict off allows any category, category-request cap 429. Stripe paid unlock END-TO-END in test mode PASSED: KZ fee master -> vendor-sub-gate 'USD 10 / 365 days', write 402, Subscribe -> Stripe hosted checkout -> 4242 card -> redirected with ?sub_session= -> builder unlocked ('Subscription active - renews 2027-10-29'), payment_transactions marked paid. R9 regression 21/21 pass serially after adapting tests for scope rules. All test artifacts cleaned up; vendor back to free.

minor.issue: Does not check that the payment_transaction belongs to the calling vendor (rec.vendor_id != vendor.id). Activation goes to the tx owner so impact is low, but any vendor can probe/trigger status of another vendor's session. Add an ownership check (404).

Vendor can submit a draft missing work_description; it only fails at reviewer approve time with 422 'Tender is missing required fields before it can be published: description'. Validate publish-required fields at submit time so the reviewer doesn't receive unpublishable tenders.

A vendor's own REJECTED master still appears in that vendor's 'Master Library' (scope_filter allows owner_vendor_id match) with a 'Clone as draft' button and no rejected badge; admins also see rejected/pending vendor masters in Master Library and in the DPR modal master dropdown. Filter moderation_status rejected (or badge it) in library lists.

Pre-existing / playbook: no brute-force lockout observed - 6 consecutive wrong passwords on an existing vendor, then correct password still returned 200. CORS responds Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (no credentials) for any Origin incl. https://evil.example (config.CORS_ORIGINS='*'). Not part of this change set.

ui_bugs.issue: While the background fill runs, Save (tb-save), section editors and per-section save are NOT disabled although the panel says 'Editing is paused until it finishes'. A manual Save during the run would PATCH the stale in-memory doc (empty bodies) and can overwrite sections the worker already saved. Disable editing/save while aiFillBusy (or merge server state).

Results are applied only after Promise.all; a file that fails fast (blank PDF) keeps showing 'reading upload - 0%' progress until the other files finish. Patch the row to error state as soon as its own job fails.

issues: Budget shows raw '500000' (no thousands separator / currency formatting).

action_items: Disable tb-save / section editing while AI Fill All background job runs (or reload server state before any save) to avoid overwriting AI-filled sections.
Validate publish-required header fields (e.g. work_description) at submit-review time, not only at reviewer approve.
Hide or badge rejected vendor masters in Master Library / DPR master dropdown (owner vendor + admin).

Note: R9 suite shares state across classes (vendor_b fixture, state['a_tid']) and fails under the default pytest.ini '-n 2 --dist loadscope'; run with '-n 0' or refactor to module-level single-class flow.
(Pre-existing, optional) brute-force lockout on vendor login; restrict CORS origins.
critical_code_review_comments: tender_pro.py: asyncio.create_task(...) results for _dpr_job_worker/_fill_worker are not retained - Python may GC un-referenced tasks; keep them in a module-level set and discard on done.

tender_pro.py _fill_worker: stale detection relies on updated_at which only refreshes between sections; with 300s threshold this is OK, but a single LLM call > 300s would let a second job start concurrently on the same template.
TenderBuilderPanel.runAiFillAll: after completion it calls openTemplate(tid) even if the user navigated to another draft meanwhile - jumps them back.
TenderBuilderPanel.jsx is 812 lines and DprGenerateModal.jsx ~495 lines - consider splitting.

rca of the issue: P0 '1 DPR(s) failed': frontend used synchronous /dpr/analyze-json for files <4MB; real DPR analysis exceeds ~60s gateway timeout.
